# Kiki Kafé

> Kiki Kafé, also spelled Kiki Cafe, is a coffee shop inside The Mall at Partridge Creek in Clinton Township, MI. Lattes, matcha, brunch and desserts.

Kiki Kafé is at 17370 Hall Rd Ste 107, Clinton Township, MI 48038, in Macomb County. The Kiki Kart is a mobile coffee cart based at that address that serves events in Macomb County and Oakland County, MI.
